title: Grand marches, call-outs and invitation-only society balls
summary: Joseph explains how old bands opened balls with a march and call-out, and how invitations are now checked.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: You can learn a whole lot from them old fellas. Those old fellas, did they play a lot of waltzes too?
Yeah, yeah, they play a lot of them purely. That's the main band. A young band don't play nothing like that.
See the young generation, they don't know nothing about no waltzes. And you catch all right, you catch them big bands, you never catch them playing no waltzes.

Now they might, now you catch them big bands that play like grand marches, grand marches like that, and marches like that. Would you start out with a march?
You start out with a march.
You see, you start out with a march, and you swing around to a fox trough. Did everybody line up then with their fire?
